title: Little Weather Station
hook: One reading joins another before we describe the sky.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: two short beats before answer confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D preschool weather-station storybook, simple instruments and sky backdrop, bright educational colors, clean contours

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child using simple station instruments with adult guidance
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written measurement workflow; non-instruments are conditions or human context
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: station cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe instrument/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. glockenspiel or marimba weather-signals after the word, with percussion ducking on onset
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: glockenspiel or marimba weather-signals after the word, with percussion ducking on onset
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Build a real little weather station workflow: sense wind, temperature, pressure, humidity/cloud state, compare readings, then write observations; ordinary gear appears only as nearby human context.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child moves instrument to instrument—anemometer, gauge, thermometer, vane—then matches numbers with visible sky clues without claiming one device predicts everything.
semanticArc: finish by logging rather than overpredicting
